name: ml-deep-learning
description: Use when the user asks about PyTorch or Keras training loops, nn.Module and DataLoader, CNNs, RNN/LSTM, transformers, mixed precision, torch.compile, gradient clipping or debugging a model that will not converge. Produces architecture and training-loop code with checkpoints and evaluation. Not for multi-GPU parallelism (use distributed-training) or LLM fine-tuning (use llm-finetuning).
